page.layout: One page: a book cover in limp vellum binding, with no printed text. Along the left edge is a handwritten spine label, partly cut off.
page.notes: The scan shows the outside of a vellum binding, not a printed page. The only marks are a handwritten label fragment on the spine edge at the left, a few ink or pencil strokes across the upper centre, and stains and wear. None of this is printed text, so nothing is transcribed.
